javascriptTypeScriptFrontendBackend.english: I have over 20 years of experience in web development. My background in C# and particularly teaching TypeScript for the past three years as a web development instructor gives me solid skills in TypeScript both backend and frontend.

Durch meinen Hintergrund in C# und insbesondere durch die Vermittlung von TypeScript in den letzten drei Jahren als Dozent für Webentwicklung habe ich solide Kenntnisse in TypeScript sowohl im Backend als auch im Frontend.

gitDocker.english: While I am old enough to have used CVS and SVN back in the day, Git has been the standard version control system in all projects and jobs I have been involved in during the past 10 years. I began using Docker at my web developer position at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021, and currently use it extensively to host fullstack applications on Hetzner machines.

reactNative.english: While React is the central topic that I have been teaching to web developer students in the last three years, I also teach workshops on React Native to introduce the students to mobile development.

serverless.english: Serverless cloud functions is a concept that I teach in my classes, demonstrating this with serverless functions at Netlify and Vercel.

awsLambda.english: AWS Lambda was used in projects I was involved in as a web developer at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021.

devops.english: As cloud technology became an increased focus in projects in the past ten years, I have been increasingly involved in devop tasks such as creating GitHub Actions and setting up deployment workflows for fullstack applications hosted on Hetzner machines.

engineeringPractices.english: The standard engineering practices such as Clean Code, DRY, pair programming, extreme programming, infrastructure-as-code, as well as functional and OOP design patterns are familiar to me.

agileScrum.english: All projects I have worked in during the last ten years have had one version or another of agile development practices, particularly the daily stand-up scrum meeting as well as developer meetings to organize tasks on task boards and for planning sprints.
agileScrum.german: Alle Projekte, an denen ich in den letzten zehn Jahren gearbeitet habe, verfügten über eine angepassten Konstellation agiler Entwicklungspraktiken, insbesondere das tägliche Stand-up-Scrum-Meeting sowie Entwickler Meetings zur Organisation von Aufgaben auf Taskboards und zur Planung von Sprints.

selfLearning.english: For an example of my appetite for learning and self-development, please see my over 800 howtos that I have produced in recent years.

vanillaJavaScript.english: I have been programming with JavaScript for over 20 years. Here's an example of a Vanilla JavaScript site I created to teach these skills: html-css-js-learn-template
vanillaJavaScript.german: Ich programmiere seit über 20 Jahren mit JavaScript. In meinem aktuellen Job als Dozent für Webentwicklung bringe ich den Studenten bei, wie sie mit Vanilla JavaScript komplexe Websites ohne JavaScript-Framework erstellen können.

html5css3.english: I've been creating websites with HTML and CSS since the 1990s and throughout the years have upgraded my skills in these technologies as newer versions have been released such as the semantic features in HTML5 and particularly Flexbox and Grid in CSS3.

frameworksLikeReact.english: My strongest skills are in React with which I have been developing websites for over three years but I also teach and create sites with Next.js, Svelte, SvelteKit, Vue, and Angular 17.

cssPreprocessorOfChoice.english: At the moment my CSS preprocessor of choice is Sass, although I find myself using Tailwind for almost all of my projects now which takes care of 90% of the styling and anything I can't do easily with Tailwind, I do with Sass. Tailwind and Sass work well together in all frameworks I have used them in. For projects that may need a Tailwind-only solution, you could use PostCSS to achieve Sass features such as Mixins since Tailwind already uses PostCSS.

toolingRollupWebpackNpmscripts.english: My bundler of choice has been Parcel since it is the simplest to use if you have generic bundling needs. I am familiar with Rollup from my use of Vite, and have used Webpack in the past. For most sites that I host on Hetzner machines, I use npm scripts for the setup and deployment scripts.

webBrowserEcosystem.english: I've been keeping up on the browser ecosystem ever since the browser wars of the 1990s and throughout my many battles with Netscape 4 and Internet Explorer 6.

astro.english: This March I took Jason Lengstorf's Frontend Masters course on Astro. Here are my notes on the course during which I produced this website. I found the concept of partial hydration particularly interesting, as well as the fact that you can use React components in Astro sites. If you need to reduce the amount of JavaScript sent to browsers, Astro can be a useful framework.

highLevelDeliverables.english: I am a pragmatist who knows the value of quick-and-dirty coding in order to push features and bug fixes to the customer as quickly as possible, but I am also a purist who strives to perfect processes as much as possible.
highLevelDeliverables.german: Ich bin ein Pragmatiker, der den Wert von quick-and-dirty code kennt, um so schnell wie möglich dem Kunden Features zu erstellen und Bugs zu lösen. Gleichzeitig bin ich aber auch ein Purist, der versucht, Prozesse so weit wie möglich zu perfektionieren.

communicationSkills.english: I have a Masters Degree in English and Linguistics, and good communication skills in both English and German.

englishSkills.english: I am a native speaker of English.

videoExperience.english: Video streaming would be a new and exciting area for me.

advertisementStacks.english: Advertising stacks would also be a new area for me.

node.english: I have been teaching the MERN stack for the past three years of which Node is a core component and before that created Node/Express/React sites for internal task management tools. I have used Node extensively to build both REST-based and GraphQL APIs with Express and backend data-driven web servers with EJS and Mustache templating engines which connect to MongoDB and MySQL databases.
node.german: Bei meiner jetzigen Tätigkeit als Dozent für Webentwicklung unterrichte ich seit drei Jahren den MERN-Stack, wo Node eine Kernkomponente ist. Ich verwende Node, um Backend-APIs mit Express und datengesteuerte Backend-Webservers mit EJS- und Mustache-Template-Engines zu erstellen, die eine Verbindung zu MongoDB- und MySQL-Datenbanken herstellen.

firebaseEtc.english: In my teaching, I have used supabase as an example of using a realtime database with Node/Express APIs.

realtimeSystems.english: I can't say that I am an expert in real-time systems at the moment, but I would be very interested in hearing what kinds of real-time systems you plan to develop.

fullstackApplicationsInUse.english: During my over 20 years of experience as a web developer, I have built and help build numerous applications that businesses and customers use. Most of my professional experience since 2001 has been in the .NET/C# and LAMP (PHP/MySQL) stacks. Since 2018, I have been working in teams developing and training others how to build web applications in the MERN stack (Node/Express, React and MongoDB).
fullstackApplicationsInUse.german: Während meiner über 20-jährigen Erfahrung als Webentwickler habe ich zahlreiche Anwendungen erstellt. Den Großteil meiner Berufserfahrung seit 2001 habe ich in den Stacks .NET/C# und LAMP (PHP/MySQL) gesammelt. Seit 2018 arbeite ich im Bereich MERN-Stack (Node/Express/MongoDB und React).

vcBackedStartup.english: Particularly during my time with ASDIS Software AG, I was part of a company that was backed by VC money and was expanding rapidly.

broadProductRequirements.english: I've always been interested in a broad spectrum of technologies to solve real-world business problems, which my Howto site indicates with over 800 howtos on how to solve problems with a wide spectrum of technologies. Even if you never use a particular technology, understanding it can lead to you adapting concepts that you otherwise wouldn't have come into contact with, and you often find yourself applying these concepts in situatations that move your real-world projects forward. For this reason, I find it exciting to brainstorm, explore new ideas, and help shape the direction of a product in its early stages.

guidingTeams.english: In my current role as a web development instructor for the past three years, I have been guiding teams of students for the past three years in building fullstack MERN applications by providing comprehensive instruction on MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js, facilitating hands-on projects, mentoring them through the development process, and fostering a collaborative learning environment to ensure they gain practical experience and confidence in their skills.

basicMernStackWithTypeScriptAws.english: For the past three years, I have been developing MERN stack applications and teaching these skills to developers, which include the core technologies of React, Next.js, Node, Express and MongoDB. In our curriculum, we require and use TypeScript in the frontend and backend. Beyond using MongoDB database in the cloud at MongoDB Atlas, we also use online MySQL and PostgreSQL databases in our projects. While employed at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021, we used AWS EC2 machines daily to manage our public-facing machines.

computerScienceDegreeOrSimilar.english: I started programming computers in the 80s and was creating database-driven websites for university projects in the 90s. Since 2001 when I joined Microsoft, I have worked as a full-time, professional web developer at numerous companies in various technology platforms including .NET/C# and the LAMP and MERN stacks.
computerScienceDegreeOrSimilar.german: In den 90er Jahren habe ich schon datenbankbasierte Websites für Universitätsprojekte erstellt. javascriptJava.english: I have been using JavaScript for application development since the early 2000s with the advent of AJAX which enabled websites to communicate directly with the server. javascriptJava.german: Seit Anfang der 2000er Jahre verwende ich JavaScript für die Anwendungsentwicklung. angularReact.english: While React is the central framework that I have been using and teaching for the last five years, I also create Angular sites such as the this task management site for my open-source project which I created with Angular 17.

cicd.english: As cloud technology became an increased focus in projects in the past ten years, I have been increasingly involved in CI/CD tasks such as creating GitHub Actions and setting up deployment workflows for fullstack application projects hosted on Hetzner machines.

teamWorkSolutionOriented.german: In meinen 20 Jahren der Softwareentwicklung habe ich immer im Team gearbeitet. Ich bin überzeugt davon, dass eine gute Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit im Team die Basis für den Erfolg jedes Projekts bilden.

goodUnderstandingTechnology.german: Insbesondere meine Projekterfahrung in einer breiten Palette von Technologien und Plattformen hat mir ein gutes Verständnis von den relevanten technologischen und operativen Prozessen technischen Projekten verschaffen.

germanEnglish.english: I am fluent in written and spoken German (Zentrale Oberstufenprüfung des Goethe Instituts in 2003: sehr gut / gut). As an American native speaker and trained English teacher, my written and spoken English skills are perfect.

nestjs.english: NestJS is one of the backend frameworks I teach to my students along with its frontend counterpart Angular in the MVC/OOP section of my web development course.

webTechnologies.english: I've been working with and keeping up on the browser ecosystem ever since the browser wars of the 1990s and throughout my many battles with Netscape 4 and Internet Explorer 6. I have decade-long, solid skills in frontend development.
webTechnologies.german: Mit Frontend-Architekturen arbeite ich seit der 90er Jahren. Ich habe im Laufe der Zeit jedes Update dieser Technologien miterlebt und gelernt, beispielsweise semantische Änderungen in HTML5, Flexbox und Grid in CSS3, und die neuen ES6 Features in JavaScript. Ich verfüge über jahrzehntelange, solide Kenntnisse in der Frontend-Entwicklung.

vueSvelteSolidjsReact.english: While my strongest skills are in the React and Next.js ecosystem, I teach SvelteKit in my classes as an alternative framework that has important of features of reactivity and static site generation. While working at zappmedia GmbH from 2014 to 2018, we replaced Smarty (a PHP template engine) with Vue to make the frontend of our static PHP website fully interactive. I teach both Vue and Nuxt as alternative frameworks in my class as well. From the videos of Ryan Carniato's 4-hour SolidJS course on Frontend Masters that I watched, I was impressed with his knowledge of frameworks, although SolidJS seems to have many reactive features that in my opinion are more elegantly solved by Svelte, although I would love to discuss the comparison of these frameworks with you, and why one would use one over the other in specific cases.
vueSvelteSolidjsReact.german: Obwohl meine stärksten Fähigkeiten im React- und Next.js-Ökosystem liegen, unterrichte ich in meinen Kursen SvelteKit als alternatives Framework, das wichtige Funktionen für Reaktivität und statische Site-Generierung bietet. Während meiner Arbeit bei der zappmedia GmbH von 2014 bis 2018 haben wir Smarty (eine PHP-Template-Engine) durch Vue ersetzt, um das Frontend unserer statischen PHP-Website vollständig interaktiv zu gestalten. Ich unterrichte in meinem Kurs auch Vue und Nuxt als alternative Frameworks. In den Videos von Ryan Carniatos 4-stündigem SolidJS-Kurs auf Frontend Masters, die ich mir angesehen habe, war ich von seinem Wissen über Frameworks beeindruckt, obwohl SolidJS viele reaktive Funktionen zu haben scheint, die meiner Meinung nach von Svelte eleganter gelöst werden. Ich würde jedoch gerne den Vergleich dieser Frameworks mit Ihnen besprechen und warum man in bestimmten Fällen das eine dem anderen vorziehen sollte.

enthusiasticTechnicalConcepts.english: For an example of my enthusiasm for technical and web development topics, please see my over 800 howtos that I have produced in recent years.

independentGoalOriented.english: I enjoy taking personal responsibility for tasks from beginning to end, and work best in an environment with clearly-stated goals.

htmlCssJavascript.english: I've been creating websites with HTML, CSS and JavaScript since the 1990s and throughout the years have upgraded my skills in these technologies as newer versions have been released such as the semantic features in HTML5, Flexbox and Grid in CSS3 and the many changes in JavaScript including the many new features in ES6, object-oriented JavaScript and the gradual use of TypeScript over JavaScript in complex projects.

php.german: Seit 2005 verwende ich objektorientiertes PHP in vielen verschiedenen Projekten und Unternehmen, um Website-Anwendungen und Backend-APIs zu erstellen. 2008 produzierte ich für das österreichische Unternehmen Video2Brain (jetzt im Besitz von LinkedIn) ein 8-stündiges Schulungsvideo "Professionelles Programmieren in PHP". Siehe eines meiner Videos aus dieser Serie: Lambdas und Closures.

sass.english: I use Sass in projects both as the main CSS strategy (e.g. using the 7-1 Sass folder structure pattern), but also as a supporting technology to Tailwind in projects where I explicitly need the more advanced features of Sass such as mixins and color functions.
sass.german: Ich verwende Sass in Projekten sowohl als Haupt-CSS-Strategie (z.B. mithilfe des 7-1 Sass Folder Structure Pattern), aber auch als unterstützende Technologie für Tailwind in Projekten, in denen ich ausdrücklich die erweiterten Funktionen von Sass wie Mixins und Farbfunktionen benötige.

mysql.english: I have been using MySQL in LAMP stack projects since the early 2000s. I have a solid knowledge of both classic SQL as well as using cloud- and Docker-hosted MySQL instances with ORMs like Prisma.
mysql.german: Seit Anfang der 2000er Jahre verwende ich MySQL in LAMP-Stack Projekten. Ich verfüge über solide Kenntnisse sowohl in klassischem SQL als auch in der Verwendung von in der Cloud oder Docker gehosteten MySQL-Instanzen mit ORMs wie Prisma.

laravel.english: As part of the fullstack webdevelopment course I teach at Digital Career Institute in Berlin, I demonstrate how to build a Laravel website and host it at Render.com with Docker.
laravel.german: Im Rahmen des Full-Stack-Webentwicklungskurses, den ich am Digital Career Institute in Berlin unterrichte, zeige ich, wie man eine Laravel-Website erstellt und sie mit Docker bei Render.com hostet.

vue.english: While working at zappmedia GmbH from 2014 to 2018, we replaced Smarty (a PHP template engine) with Vue to make the frontend of our static PHP website fully interactive. I teach both Vue and Nuxt as alternative frameworks in my class as well.
vue.german: Während meiner Tätigkeit bei der zappmedia GmbH von 2014 bis 2018 haben wir Smarty (eine PHP-Template-Engine) durch Vue ersetzt, um das Frontend unserer statischen PHP-Website vollständig interaktiv zu gestalten. Ich unterrichte in meinem MERN-Stack Webentwicklungskurs auch Vue und Nuxt als alternative Frameworks.

excitementLearn.english: For an example of my ability to learn quickly and efficiently in new technologies, please see my over 800 howtos that I have produced in recent years.
excitementLearn.german: Ein Beispiel für meine Begeisterung, neue Technologien zu lernen, finden Sie in meinen über 800 Howtos, die ich in den letzten Jahren erstellt habe.

nextjs.english: For the past three years, I have been teaching the MERN stack at the Digital Career Institute in Berlin with both React and Next.js as the frontend framework. My skills ins both frameworks are very good.
nextjs.german: In den letzten drei Jahren habe ich am Digital Career Institute in Berlin den MERN-Stack unterrichtet, mit React und Next.js als Frontend-Framework. Meine Kenntnisse in beiden Frameworks sind sehr gut.

cleancode.english: Robert Martin's Clean Code guidelines is something I know well and have internalized many of the coding practices in my day-to-day work, especially "keep it simple", "always find the root cause" and "make functions them do one thing only"
cleancode.german: Die Clean Code-Richtlinien von Robert Martin sind mir gut bekannt und ich habe viele der Regeln in meiner täglichen Arbeit verinnerlicht, insbesondere "keep it simple", "always find the root cause" und "make functions do one thing only".

sql.english: MySQL in LAMP stack projects is a technology I have been using since the early 2000s. I have a solid knowledge of both classic SQL and using cloud or Docker hosted MySQL and Postgres instances with ORMs like Prisma.
sql.german: MySQL in LAMP-Stack-Projekten ist eine Technologie, die ich seit Anfang der 2000er Jahre verwende. Ich verfüge über fundierte Kenntnisse sowohl in klassischem SQL als auch in der Verwendung von Docker gehosteten MySQL- und Postgres-Instanzen mit ORMs wie Prisma.

apiDesign.english: REST and API design is a standard topic that I have been teaching for the past three years in my MERN-stack classes in which we build backend APIs with Node and Express. We look at various structures such as the standard router/handler approach, classic MVC and backend frameworks such as NestJS.
apiDesign.german: REST- und API-Design ist ein Standardthema, das ich seit drei Jahren in meinen MERN-Stack-Kursen unterrichte, in denen wir Backend-APIs mit Node und Express erstellen. Wir betrachten verschiedene Strukturen wie den Standard-Router/Handler-Ansatz, klassisches MVC und Backend-Frameworks wie NestJS.

docker.english: At my web developer position at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021, we used Docker extensively as part of our project to move customer web applications from Strato to AWS, and currently I use Docker to host fullstack React and Next.js applications on Hetzner machines.
docker.german: In meiner Position als Webentwickler bei GEFEG mbH von 2018 bis 2021 haben wir Docker im Rahmen unseres Projektes zur Migration von Kunden-Webanwendungen von Strato zu AWS umfassend verwendet, und derzeit verwende ich Docker, um Fullstack-React- und Next.js-Anwendungen auf Hetzner-Maschinen zu hosten.

kubernetes.english: I have limited experience with Kubernetes but look forward to using it in a project which warrants its use.
kubernetes.german: Ich habe nur begrenzte Erfahrung mit Kubernetes, freue mich aber darauf, es in einem Projekt einzusetzen, bei dem seine Verwendung gerechtfertigt ist.

testing.english: Through my 20-year developer experience, I have learned that even for mid-sized projects of moderate complexity, good testing practices will save time, make code easier to read, enable new team members to get up to speed faster, and give the project stability and developers the confidence to make non-trivial changes even in the largest of projects.
testing.german: Durch meine 20-jährige Erfahrung als Entwickler habe ich gelernt, dass gute Testverfahren von Vorteil sind, selbst bei mittelgroßen Projekten mit mäßiger Komplexität. Sie sparen Zeit, machen den Code leichter lesbar, neue Teammitglieder können sich schneller einarbeiten, und das Projekt wird stabiler, so dass auch wesentliche Änderungen sicher durchgeführt werden können.

willingnessToLearn.english: For an example of my willingness to learn new technologies, please see my over 800 howtos that I have produced in recent years.
willingnessToLearn.german: Ein Beispiel für meine Begeisterung, neue Technologien zu lernen, finden Sie in meinen über 800 Howtos, die ich in den letzten Jahren erstellt habe.

workingWithExistingCodebase.english: Most of the jobs and projects I have had in my 20 years of developer experience have been maintaining and expanding existing code bases, particularly the many PHP projects I have assumed responsibility for which were originally started by an employee who was no longer working for the company. I have good skills in analyzing code, making changes where necessary to accomplish tasks, and writing enough tests to make sure these changes work as expected in the future.

problemSolvingDesignDebugging.english: Jobs and projects I have had over the last two decades of developing software have mostly been in the capacity of a fullstack developer. This means that everything from frontend design to backend databases were my responsibility. Problem solving and debugging have become much easier today with the modern tools and technologies we currently have at our disposal.

growHelpColleagues.english: My long experience I have as a fullstack developer, and particularly my experience during the last three years of teaching and giving daily live-coding sessions to over 20 students in online web development courses makes me the perfect candidate to learn with and help my colleagues in teams I work in. The subjects I teach throughout the year are Frontend (React, Typescript, Sass, Tailwind), Backend (Node, Express, TypeScript), Databases (MongoDB, MySQL, Postgres, Prisma), Security (bcrypt, JWT, sessions/cookies, Zod, Kinde), Deployment (Vercel, Render, Cyclic, Hetzner, Nginx, PM2, Docker), and Testing (Jest, Vitest, Supertest, Cypress).

softwareDevelopment.english: I have been developing software and web applications for over 20 years.
softwareDevelopment.german: Über 20 Jahren entwickle ich Software und Webanwendungen.

architectureSolutionsProcesses.english: Through my over 20 years professional experience of software development, I have acquired solid knowledge in this field. In almost all of my projects and jobs, analyzing and optimizing complex IT architectures as well as developing custom solutions for various requirements, was the core of my responsibilities.
architectureSolutionsProcesses.german: Durch meine über 20-jährige Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung habe ich mir fundierte Kenntnisse in diesem Bereich angeeignet. In nahezu allen meinen Projekten und Jobs war die Analyse und Optimierung komplexer IT-Architekturen sowie die Entwicklung individueller Lösungen für unterschiedliche Anforderungen der Kern meiner Aufgaben.

versionControl.english: While I am old enough to have used CVS and SVN back in the day, Git has been the standard version control system in all projects and jobs I have been involved in during the past 10 years.
versionControl.german: Obwohl ich erfahren genug bin, früher CVS und SVN verwendet zu haben, seit den letzten 10 Jahren verwende ich Git, GitLab und GitHub in allen Projekten und Jobs.

frontendTesting.english: Frontend testing tools that I have used are Jest, Vitest, Mocha/Chai as well as React Testing Library.
frontendTesting.german: Zu den Frontend-Testtools, die ich verwendet habe, gehören Jest, Vitest, Mocha/Chai sowie die React Testing Library.

experienceLargeComplexSystems.english: During my over 20 years of experience as a web developer, I have worked in large teams that have built numerous enterprise-level applications, for instance during my employment as a Microsoft Consultant, I was responsible for Frontend development in a two-year-long research software project for the Polizei Rheinland-Pfalz, and worked on the backend of a bus ticketing system for Siemens VDO in Berlin.
experienceLargeComplexSystems.german: Während meiner über 20-jährigen Erfahrung als Webentwickler habe ich in großen Teams gearbeitet, die zahlreiche Anwendungen auf Unternehmensebene erstellt haben. Während meiner Anstellung als Microsoft Consultant und Entwickler war ich beispielsweise für die Frontend-Entwicklung in einem zweijährigen Forschungssoftwareprojekt für die Polizei Rheinland-Pfalz verantwortlich und habe am Backend eines Busticketsystems für Siemens VDO in Berlin gearbeitet.

scaleUpStartUp.english: From 2005-2006, I worked for a company called ASDIS Software that was successful in the German market and received VC money to expand globally, and so could be considered a scale-up company. And much earlier in my career, in 1985 in the United States at the age of 19, I joined my brother in a software company he had created a year earlier. We developed applications in DBase II and Clipper for insurance companies, banks and hospitals. For those two years, it was only the two of us, and even though I don't think the word "startup" had been invented yet, it definitely had all the stress and excitement of a startup.

eventDrivenArchitecture.english: Microservices is a topic I teach in my web developer course at Digital Career Institute, and one particular .NET project for Avario Business Solutions GmbH from 2009-2010 involved us implementing the .NET WCF SOA framework which focuses on contracts and messages exchange.

postgres.english: Setting up a Postgres database on Ubuntu Linux and using it in a Node/Express API is a topic that I teach in my web developer course at Digital Career Services.

mentorship.english: Mentorship is an integral part of my teaching philosophy and when I have been in senior positions in developer teams, allowing students or co-developers to take on challenging tasks and supporting them through the thought process as well as technical debugging and problem solving.

codeReview.english: Exactly, code reviews serve the dual purpose of both improving the code quality of the project at hand, as well as being a tool to continually level-up the skills of all team members. Code reviews enable everyone on the team to go beyond a simplistic right/wrong approach to programming. They help team members over time develop a more nuanced and senior outlook of the wider software development craft. A team's strategic and organized use of code reviews helps team members develop skills which involve every aspect of software development from understanding the wider architecture, to pragmatic decisions based on customer need, to the most efficient way to implement new technologies, to understanding the importance and limits of testing, to the application of abstract patterns that solve real-world problems.

equivalentBaschelorsDegree.english: While I have both a Bachelors and Masters degree in subjects other than computer science, I started programming computers in the 1980s and was creating database-driven websites for university projects by the end of the 90s. Since 2001 when I joined Microsoft as a Fullstack Developer Consultant, I have been working as a full-time, professional web developer at numerous companies, on various-sized projects, and in at least three technology platforms including .NET/C# and the LAMP and MERN stacks.
equivalentBaschelorsDegree.german: In den 90er Jahren habe ich schon datenbankbasierte Websites für Universitätsprojekte erstellt. Seit meinem Einstieg bei Microsoft im Jahr 2001 habe ich als Fullstack Entwickler für verschiedene Unternehmen auf unterschiedlichen Technologieplattformen gearbeitet, u.a. .NET/C# und die LAMP- und MERN-Stacks.

git.english: While I am old enough to have used CVS and SVN back in the day, Git has been the standard version control system in all projects and jobs I have been involved in during the past 10 years.
git.german: Obwohl ich erfahren genug bin, um früher CVS und SVN verwendet zu haben, wird Git in allen Projekten verwendet, an denen ich in den letzten 10 Jahren beteiligt war.

rest.english: REST is a standard topic that I have been teaching for the past three years as a web developer instructor as part of the MERN-stack, e.g. for building backend APIs with Node and Express which connect to MongoDB and MySQL databases.
rest.german: REST ist ein Standardthema, das ich seit drei Jahren als Dozent für Webentwicklung im Rahmen des MERN-Stacks unterrichte, z.B. das Erstellen von Backend-APIs mit Node und Express, die eine Verbindung zu MongoDB- und MySQL-Datenbanken herstellen.

databaseDesign.english: Database design has been a core responsibility in projects of mine within the last 20 years both in LAMP-stack projects with MySQL and Postgres as well as .NET with SQL Server.
databaseDesign.german: In den letzten 20 Jahren war Datenbankdesign eine meiner Kernaufgaben in Projekten, sowohl in LAMP-Stack-Projekten mit MySQL und Postgres als auch in .NET mit SQL Server.

mongodb.english: Since 2021 I have been teaching the MERN Stack to web developer students at Digital Career Institute in Berlin in which I use MongoDB both native and hosted as Docker instances. We connect these databases to Node/Express backends with both Mongoose and the ORM Prisma.
mongodb.german: Seit 2021 unterrichte ich Webentwickler-Studenten am Digital Career Institute in Berlin den MERN Stack, wobei ich MongoDB sowohl nativ als auch gehostet als Docker-Instanzen verwende. Ich verbinde diese Datenbanken mit Node/Express-Backends sowohl mit Mongoose als auch mit dem ORM Prisma.

experienceIncludingTypescript.english: My over 20 years of experience as a web developer, my background in C#, and particularly my experience teaching TypeScript for the past three years as a web development instructor at the Digital Career Institute in Berlin, gives me solid skills in TypeScript both backend and frontend.

typescriptOverJavascript.english: In my web development course, I teach TypeScript from the beginning when we start with the React and Next.js frameworks, after which we use TypeScript only, including tools that work closely with TypeScript such as the validation tool Zod and ORM database tools such as Prisma. For backend APIs we set up TypeScript development environments so that we get TypeScript support and type safety in the VSCode editor as well as during deployment to servers such as Vercel or custom deployment scenarios e.g. cloud hosting at Hetzner.

storybookAntdesign.english: I have limited experience with both Storybook and Ant Design, but look forward to learning and using both of them in projects, as they seem to both be a way to better organize components in React projects, particularly when working in teams.

testingTools.english: Testing tools that I teach and use are Jest or more recently Vitest/TypeScript, as well as React Testing Library for frontend. To test APIs I use a combination of Vitest and Supertest. End-to-end testing I mainly use Cypress.

vueReactSolidjs.english: My strongest skills are in the React and Next.js ecosystem, while I also teach the frameworks SvelteKit and SolidJS in my classes as an alternative framework that has features of reactivity and static site generation. While working at zappmedia GmbH from 2014 to 2018, we replaced Smarty (a PHP template engine) with Vue to make the frontend of our static PHP website fully interactive. I teach both Vue and Nuxt as alternative frameworks in my class.
vueReactSolidjs.german: Meine größten Fähigkeiten liegen im React- und Next.js Stacks, wobei ich in meinen Kursen auch die Frameworks SvelteKit und SolidJS unterrichte als Einführung in das Thema Reactivity. Während meiner Tätigkeit bei der zappmedia GmbH von 2014 bis 2018 haben wir Smarty (eine PHP-Template-Engine) durch Vue ersetzt, um das Frontend unserer statischen PHP-Website vollständig interaktiv zu gestalten. Ich unterrichte in meinem Kurs sowohl Vue als auch Nuxt als alternative Frameworks.

vueReact.english: My strongest skills are in the React and Next.js ecosystem. While working at zappmedia GmbH from 2014 to 2018, I was responsible for replacing Smarty (a PHP template engine) with Vue to make the frontend of our static PHP website fully interactive. I teach both Vue and Nuxt as alternative frameworks in my class as Digital Career Institute.
vueReact.german: Meine größten Fähigkeiten liegen im React- und Next.js-Ökosystem. Während meiner Tätigkeit bei der zappmedia GmbH von 2014 bis 2018 war ich dafür verantwortlich, Smarty (eine PHP-Template-Engine) durch Vue zu ersetzen, um das Frontend unserer statischen PHP-Website vollständig interaktiv zu gestalten. In meinem Kurs am Digital Career Institute unterrichte ich sowohl Vue als auch Nuxt als alternative Frameworks.

shareWithTeam.english: For an example of how I share my knowledge with other developers, please see my over 800 howtos which I have produced over the last five years.

berlinRosenthalerPlatz.english: I live in Berlin and have easy access to Rosenthaler Platz with BVG.

java.english: The syntax and OOP structure of Java is familiar to me through my knowlege and experience with C#.

aws.english: I began using AWS and Docker at my web developer position at GEFEG mbh from 2018 to 2021 where I was responsible for moving our Strato infrastructure to AWS.

fullstackApplications.english: During my over 20 years of experience as a web developer, I have built and help build numerous applications that businesses and customers use. Most of my professional experience since 2001 has been in the .NET/C# and LAMP (PHP/MySQL) stacks. Since 2018, I have been working in teams developing and training others how to build web applications in the MERN stack (Node/Express, React and MongoDB).
fullstackApplications.german: Den Großteil meiner Berufserfahrung seit 2001 habe ich als Fullstack Entwickler gearbeiet, vor allem in den Stacks .NET/C# und LAMP (PHP/MySQL). Seit 2018 arbeite ich im Bereich MERN-Stack (Node/Express/MongoDB und React).

nearMuenster.english: I live in Berlin and would gladly travel 1-2 time per month to the Campus in Schöppingen.
nearMuenster.german: Ich wohne in Berlin und würde gerne 1-2 mal im Monat zum Campus nach Schöppingen fahren.
